# 1. Loading and QC
```{r warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(scDblFinder)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db) # This is the Human Genome database!
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Load Data
barcodes_df <- fread("~/Desktop/PD_Project_Fresh/barcodes_FIXED.tsv", header = TRUE)
features_df <- fread("~/Desktop/PD_Project_Fresh/features_FIXED.tsv", header = TRUE)

cell_names <- as.character(barcodes_df$barcode)

# ROOT FIX: Translate Ensembl IDs to Gene Symbols immediately upon loading
raw_genes <- as.character(features_df$gene)
if (any(grepl("^ENSG", raw_genes))) {
  message("Translating Ensembl IDs to official gene symbols using org.Hs.eg.db...")
  mapped_syms <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                        keys = raw_genes,
                        column = "SYMBOL",
                        keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                        multiVals = "first")
  gene_names <- make.unique(ifelse(is.na(mapped_syms), raw_genes, mapped_syms))
} else {
  gene_names <- make.unique(raw_genes)
}

n_cells <- length(cell_names)
chunk_size <- 5000
col_indices <- 1:n_cells
chunks <- split(col_indices, ceiling(seq_along(col_indices) / chunk_size))
full_sparse_matrix <- NULL

for (i in seq_along(chunks)) {
  dt_chunk <- fread("~/Desktop/PD_Project_Fresh/matrix.mtx", select = chunks[[i]], header = FALSE, skip = 1)
  mat_chunk <- as.matrix(dt_chunk)
  sp_chunk <- as(mat_chunk, "dgCMatrix")

  if (is.null(full_sparse_matrix)) {
    full_sparse_matrix <- sp_chunk
  } else {
    full_sparse_matrix <- cbind(full_sparse_matrix, sp_chunk)
  }
  rm(dt_chunk, mat_chunk, sp_chunk); gc()
}

rownames(full_sparse_matrix) <- gene_names[1:nrow(full_sparse_matrix)]
colnames(full_sparse_matrix) <- cell_names[1:ncol(full_sparse_matrix)]

pd_full <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = full_sparse_matrix, project = "PD_GSE157783")

# 2. Metadata
pd_full$Patient_ID <- barcodes_df$patient
pd_full$Condition <- ifelse(grepl("PD", pd_full$Patient_ID), "PD", "Control")

# 3. Doublet Detection
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(pd_full)
sce <- scDblFinder(sce, samples="Patient_ID")
pd_full$Doublet_Class <- sce$scDblFinder.class

# 4. Filter and Clean
pd_clean <- subset(pd_full, subset = Doublet_Class == "singlet")
pd_clean <- subset(pd_clean, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 9000)

# Verify PBX1 is present right from the start
print(paste("Is PBX1 present globally?", "PBX1" %in% rownames(pd_clean)))

# Clean up intermediate heavy objects
rm(sce, full_sparse_matrix)
gc()
```

##2. Normalization and PCA
```{r warning=FALSE}
library(patchwork)

# Ensure standard RNA assay is active and layers are joined
DefaultAssay(pd_clean) <- "RNA"
pd_clean <- JoinLayers(pd_clean)

# THE MISSING PIECE: Normalize the data so Seurat do the math!
pd_clean <- NormalizeData(pd_clean)

# Find variable features and explicitly SCALE DATA
pd_clean <- FindVariableFeatures(pd_clean, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pd_clean <- ScaleData(pd_clean)

# Run PCA
pd_clean <- RunPCA(pd_clean, verbose = FALSE)

p1 <- DimPlot(pd_clean, reduction = "pca", group.by = "Patient_ID") +
ggtitle("PCA by Donor") + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
p2 <- DimPlot(pd_clean, reduction = "pca", group.by = "Condition") +
ggtitle("PCA by Condition") + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

p1 + p2
```

##3. Harmony Integration
```{r warning=FALSE}
library(harmony)
library(patchwork) # Required for the p3 + p4 layout below

# 1. Calculate the PCA map first!
pd_clean <- RunPCA(pd_clean, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

# 2. Run Harmony to integrate the patients (using the updated, clean command)
pd_clean <- RunHarmony(pd_clean, group.by.vars = "Patient_ID")

# 3. Draw your Validation Plots
p3 <- DimPlot(pd_clean, reduction = "harmony", group.by = "Patient_ID") +
 ggtitle("Harmony by Donor") + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

p4 <- DimPlot(pd_clean, reduction = "harmony", group.by = "Condition") +
 ggtitle("Harmony by Condition") + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

# Display the plots side-by-side
p3 + p4 + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

##4. Clustering, Markers, and Annotation

```{r warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Reset the foundation to ensure R knows where to build the graph
DefaultAssay(pd_clean) <- "RNA"

# 2. Build the mathematical network based on the Harmony integration
pd_clean <- FindNeighbors(pd_clean, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)

# 3. Find Clusters. We explicitly tell Seurat to use the newly built RNA_snn graph to bypass the error.
pd_clean <- FindClusters(pd_clean, resolution = 0.6, graph.name = "RNA_snn")

# 4. Generate the UMAP coordinates
pd_clean <- RunUMAP(pd_clean, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)

# 5. Apply your updated, biologically verified dictionary (DA Neurons secured)
new.cluster.ids <- c(
"0" = "Oligodendrocytes",
 "1" = "Astrocytes",
 "2" = "Oligodendrocytes",
 "3" = "Oligodendrocytes",
 "4" = "Excitatory Neurons",
 "5" = "Microglia",
 "6" = "OPCs",
 "7" = "Oligodendrocytes",
 "8" = "Unknown",
 "9" = "Endothelial",
 "10" = "Pericytes",
 "11" = "Neurons (SYNPR+)",
 "12" = "Ependymal",
 "13" = "Neurons (KCNC2+)",
 "14" = "Low Quality",
 "15" = "Unknown",
 "16" = "Excitatory Neurons",
 "17" = "Fibroblasts / VLMCs",
 "18" = "Unknown",
 "19" = "Dopaminergic Neurons",
 "20" = "Neurons (STMN2+)",
 "21" = "Oligodendrocytes (LINC01608+)"
)

# 6. Match the levels and rename the clusters
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(pd_clean)
pd_clean <- RenameIdents(pd_clean, new.cluster.ids)

# 7. Save the fully baked, annotated object for your pipeline
saveRDS(pd_clean, file = "PD_40k_Fully_Annotated_FIXED.rds")

# 8. Generate and display the final annotated UMAP
DimPlot(pd_clean, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5, label.size = 3, repel = TRUE) +
ggtitle("Annotated UMAP of Human Substantia Nigra (GSE157783)") +
NoLegend()
pd_clean <- RunUMAP(pd_clean, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, seed.use = 42)
```


#Step 2: Differential Expression (PD vs Control)
#Now that the clusters are biologically annotated, we will identify the genes driving Parkinson's Disease specifically within the Dopaminergic Neurons.

```{r warning=FALSE}
# ==========================================
# STEP 2: DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION & FEATURE MAPPING
# ==========================================
library(Seurat)

# 2. Run Differential Expression for Dopaminergic Neurons
da_neurons_de <- FindMarkers(pd_clean,
                             ident.1 = "PD",
                             ident.2 = "Control",
                             group.by = "Condition",
                             subset.ident = "Dopaminergic Neurons")

da_neurons_de <- da_neurons_de[order(da_neurons_de$p_val_adj), ]
head(da_neurons_de, n = 10)

# ==========================================
# 3. DOPAMINERGIC NEURONS: VIOLIN PLOTS
# ==========================================
dying_genes <- subset(da_neurons_de, avg_log2FC < 0)
dying_genes <- dying_genes[order(dying_genes$p_val_adj), ]
head(dying_genes, n = 10)

plot_pbx1 <- VlnPlot(pd_clean,
                    features = "PBX1",
                    split.by = "Condition",
                    idents = "Dopaminergic Neurons",
                    pt.size = 0.1) +
  ggtitle("PBX1 (Survival Gene)")

plot_en2 <- VlnPlot(pd_clean,
                   features = "EN2",
                   split.by = "Condition",
                   idents = "Dopaminergic Neurons",
                   pt.size = 0.1) +
  ggtitle("EN2 (Survival Gene)")

plot_pbx1 | plot_en2

VlnPlot(pd_clean,
        features = "LINGO1",
        split.by = "Condition",
        idents = "Dopaminergic Neurons",
        pt.size = 0.1) +
  ggtitle("LINGO1 (Dying Structural Gene)")

# ==========================================
# 4. MICROGLIA ANALYSIS
# ==========================================
microglia_de <- FindMarkers(pd_clean,
                            ident.1 = "PD",
                            ident.2 = "Control",
                            group.by = "Condition",
                            subset.ident = "Microglia")

microglia_de$Gene_Symbol <- rownames(microglia_de)
microglia_de <- microglia_de[, c("Gene_Symbol", "p_val", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1", "pct.2", "p_val_adj")]

microglia_up <- subset(microglia_de, avg_log2FC > 0)
microglia_up <- microglia_up[order(microglia_up$p_val_adj), ]

microglia_down <- subset(microglia_de, avg_log2FC < 0)
microglia_down <- microglia_down[order(microglia_down$p_val_adj), ]

VlnPlot(pd_clean,
        features = "CHI3L1",
        split.by = "Condition",
        idents = "Microglia",
        pt.size = 0.1) +
  ggtitle("CHI3L1 (Microglia Inflammation)")

# ==========================================
# 5. ASTROCYTES ANALYSIS
# ==========================================
astro_de <- FindMarkers(pd_clean, 
                        ident.1 = "PD", 
                        ident.2 = "Control", 
                        group.by = "Condition", 
                        subset.ident = "Astrocytes")

astro_de$Gene_Symbol <- rownames(astro_de)
astro_de <- astro_de[, c("Gene_Symbol", "p_val", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1", "pct.2", "p_val_adj")]

VlnPlot(pd_clean,
        features = "NEAT1",
        split.by = "Condition",
        idents = "Astrocytes",
        pt.size = 0.1) +
  ggtitle("NEAT1 (Astrocyte Stress Marker)")

# ==========================================
# 6. OLIGODENDROCYTES ANALYSIS
# ==========================================
oligo_de <- FindMarkers(pd_clean, 
                        ident.1 = "PD", 
                        ident.2 = "Control", 
                        group.by = "Condition", 
                        subset.ident = "Oligodendrocytes")

oligo_de$Gene_Symbol <- rownames(oligo_de)
oligo_de <- oligo_de[, c("Gene_Symbol", "p_val", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1", "pct.2", "p_val_adj")]

VlnPlot(pd_clean,
        features = "MOBP",
        split.by = "Condition",
        idents = "Oligodendrocytes",
        pt.size = 0.1) +
  ggtitle("MOBP (Failing Myelin Structure)")
```
